# MeloCut

> MeloCut is a set of free audio tools that run entirely in the browser, on phones and computers. Files are processed on the user's device with FFmpeg (WebAssembly) and are never uploaded. No sign-up, no watermark. It makes iPhone (M4R) and Android ringtones, cuts and joins audio, converts video to MP3, converts between audio formats and adds effects such as slowed + reverb, nightcore, 8D audio, bass boost and AI noise removal.

## Tools
- [Video to MP3](https://melocut.com/video-to-mp3/): Get the sound out of an MP4, MOV or WebM video.
- [Ringtone Maker](https://melocut.com/ringtone-maker/): Turn part of a song into an iPhone or Android ringtone.
- [Audio Cutter](https://melocut.com/audio-cutter/): Trim a song or cut a piece out of the middle.
- [Audio Converter](https://melocut.com/audio-converter/): Switch between MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG and FLAC.
- [Audio Joiner](https://melocut.com/audio-joiner/): Put several songs or clips together into one file.
- [AI Noise Remover](https://melocut.com/noise-remover/): Clean up background noise in voice recordings.
- [Slowed + Reverb](https://melocut.com/slowed-reverb/): Make a slowed version of a song with reverb.
- [Vocal Remover](https://melocut.com/vocal-remover/): Take the singer out for a karaoke track.
- [Voice Changer](https://melocut.com/voice-changer/): Chipmunk, deep, robot, monster and more voices.
- [8D Audio](https://melocut.com/8d-audio/): Sound that moves from ear to ear. Use headphones.
- [Bass Booster](https://melocut.com/bass-booster/): Add more low end to any song.
- [Volume Booster](https://melocut.com/volume-booster/): Make quiet recordings louder.
- [Reverse Audio](https://melocut.com/reverse-audio/): Play any sound backwards.
- [Speed Up Audio](https://melocut.com/speed-up-audio/): Make a song or voice note faster, same pitch.
- [Slow Down Audio](https://melocut.com/slow-down-audio/): Play anything slower without a deep voice.
- [Pitch Changer](https://melocut.com/pitch-changer/): Change the key of a song, same speed.
- [Nightcore Maker](https://melocut.com/nightcore-maker/): Faster and higher, the classic nightcore sound.
- [Remove Silence](https://melocut.com/remove-silence/): Cut the long pauses out of a recording.
- [Fade In and Fade Out](https://melocut.com/fade-in-fade-out/): Add a smooth start and ending to any song.

## Converters
- [MP4 to MP3](https://melocut.com/mp4-to-mp3/)
- [WAV to MP3](https://melocut.com/wav-to-mp3/)
- [M4A to MP3](https://melocut.com/m4a-to-mp3/)
- [WhatsApp audio to MP3](https://melocut.com/whatsapp-audio-to-mp3/)
- [MP3 to WAV](https://melocut.com/mp3-to-wav/)
- [FLAC to MP3](https://melocut.com/flac-to-mp3/)
- [MOV to MP3](https://melocut.com/mov-to-mp3/)
- [OGG to MP3](https://melocut.com/ogg-to-mp3/)
- [AAC to MP3](https://melocut.com/aac-to-mp3/)
- [MP3 to M4R (iPhone ringtone)](https://melocut.com/mp3-to-m4r/)
- [MP3 to M4A](https://melocut.com/mp3-to-m4a/)
- [WebM to MP3](https://melocut.com/webm-to-mp3/)
- [OPUS to MP3](https://melocut.com/opus-to-mp3/)
